nodes.name: Document Uploaded (Webhook)
nodes.notes: Landlord's app POSTs a document (base64-encoded PDF/image), its mime_type, plus property_id and document_type_hint (rental_contract | rent_receipt | emi_statement | nebenkosten_invoice).

nodes.name: Extract Fields (OpenAI)
nodes.notes: Uses the Responses API (not Chat Completions) so a PDF can be sent directly via input_file, without a separate PDF-to-image conversion step. Credential is referenced by name only - no key is stored in this file. See .env.example / README for setup.

nodes.name: Return Draft Record to App
nodes.notes: In production this record is never auto-saved to the landlord's books from here - the frontend shows it as an editable draft. The 'save' action is a separate, human-triggered step, deliberately outside this workflow.

meta.description: Round 1 POC for the Rent/Expense/EMI Document Extraction Assistant use case (see research/use_cases.md, use case 1). Human-in-the-loop by design: every extraction, regardless of confidence, returns to the landlord as an editable draft rather than being auto-saved.
